scope: Native SET22 observed empty carrier, real open deauth/TX_DONE, firmware channel/PM/BSS/STA teardown, host queue disposal, fresh context for next explicit scan/join. Source-built subset only.

native_evidence.contract: _Apple80211SetWithIOCTL empty request initializes raw req40 to zero, sets type22, case22 WAPIStop then NULL params jumps directly to original SET wrapper. Proven value0/length0/null pointer. Reason-dictionary8-byte variant unsupported; no macOS struct ABI substituted.

primary_source.repository: local existing MediaTek Linux/DDK source port/gsi/kernel-4.14

source_contracts: ais_fsm.c aisFsmStateAbort_JOIN: cancel SAA host state, release granted/requested channel, stop join timer. aisFsmReleaseCh identifies BSS/token; cnm.c cnmChMngrAbortPrivilege: CMD1c action1, no response; only BSS/token/action meaningful.

ais_fsm.c DISCONNECTING: actual authSendDeauthFrame(reason DEAUTH_LEAVING_BSS3) + TX callback, timer100ms when neither scan nor BSS-absent. Open associated/pending-assoc subset uses same management TXD policy as existing station backend + source-established MCU TX_DONE/PID fields from existing data path. No PMF/secure mode accepted.

aisDeauthXmitComplete normally proceeds for several statuses and timeout. Our subset is STRICTER: only exact PID/WTBL successful real TX_DONE proceeds; nonzero status/wrong event/timeout fail runtime closed and quarantine indices. No timeout claimed to be deauth success.

aisFsmDisconnect: nicPmIndicateBssAbort CID17 sizeof4 then disconnected BSS update CID12 sizeof88. nicDeactivateNetwork CID11 sizeof12 zeroes MAC on deactivation, then removes STA and disposes pending data/security queues. cnmStaSendRemoveCmd CID14 sizeof4 = action0 exactSTA/BSS/reserved0, fgNeedResp FALSE. No firmware ACK inferred for set commands.

Global allocator ownership retained; old BSS/own/STA/WTBL reserved forever in this bounded subset. Separate fresh context allocated before admission; never reuse a no-response-removed index to correlate late events. Retired channel/STA events attributed by actual BSS; retired TX_DONE by actual WTBL. Finite four-BSS total budget is explicit ENOSPC before side effects.
admission_and_state: 0 means accepted real command/deauth submission, not disconnected completion. Associated/assoc-on-air preserves old association until exact TX_DONE then teardown writes succeed; admission blocks new data/auth/assoc, GET21 is unknown and current103 EAGAIN while pending. Host plaintext queue zeroed on admission or poisoned transport. Fresh station has no selected peer/no scan complete/no association; only next explicit real scan+generation/identity validated SET20 can reconnect.
security_ownership: No changes to A04BR3WLANSecurity.h, cipher/EAPOL carrier headers, key install/authorize API or credential gate. BackendAPI only adds dedicated disassociate(provider). Secure/key state EOPNOTSUPP intact; in-flight data and scan EBUSY intact. Key/firmware queue forced cancellation requires Turing/parent coordination and is not implemented.
limitations: No hardware deauth/TX_DONE/teardown/reconnect verified; actual SDK link remains parent gate.

Four BSS contexts per radio lifetime; old contexts not recycled without a proven firmware flush/epoch barrier. ENOSPC may reject further teardown requiring replacement. This is a deliberate incomplete lifecycle budget.
Secure/key/EAPOL cancellation and in-flight Ethernet/scan cancellation unsupported, not silently dropped.
Only observed empty SET22 carrier. Reason payload variants rejected. No fabricated native disconnect completion events.
Prior EEXIST for ambiguous ESS, secure association unsupported, no IP connectivity verified. Full WiFi remains incomplete.
credit: Original board-specific adapter implementation from source ABI/ordering observations. No Apple binary loaded/modified, no copied implementation code from GPL DDK or itlwm. Existing local primary source kept as provenance; no external source re-download.
